b-021.reason: à, the preposition with its grave accent as this print sets it everywhere (appartient grandement à la dignité); â with a circumflex is not a form the print uses. Translation the same.

n-a-3.reason: c. vt debitus. de appel. = the Decretals chapter Ut debitus honor under De appellationibus (X 2.28); c. is the siglum for a chapter, e. is no siglum.

n-b-1.reason: D. deposit. = Digest, Depositi vel contra (D. 16.3), the title abbreviated with its vowel; depost. drops the i and is not a usual abbreviation of the title.
